name: ai-study-companion
description: AI-powered study companion with RAG tutoring, adaptive quizzes, and mastery tracking

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND,PYTHON" -c "cyan.bold,green.bold,yellow.bold" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:python"
scripts.dev:python: cd python-service && (if exist venv\Scripts\uvicorn (venv\Scripts\uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload) else (python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload))
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
scripts.lint: cd backend && npm run lint && cd ../frontend && npm run lint
